info.name: City Clinic API
info.description:
REST API for the City Clinic management system.

**Getting started**
1. Start the server: `php -S localhost:8000` in the project folder.
2. Check the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:8000/api/api.php`).
3. Run **1. Auth → Login as Admin**. The token is saved automatically.
4. Run the other folders in order, or the whole collection with the Collection Runner (safe to run repeatedly).

Create requests save the new ids (`patientId`, `doctorId`, …) for the requests after them. `bookingDate` is automatically set to the next Sunday.

Sample logins: admin@clinic.com / Admin@123, ali@clinic.com / Reception@123, ahmed@clinic.com / Doctor@123

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description:
Log in first. The login requests save the token into the `token` collection variable, and every other request sends it as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

To test the other roles, see folder 9.

request.description: Admin can do everything. **Run this first.**
Returns the logged-in user, roles and `doctor_id` (if the user is a doctor).
Changes the logged-in user's password (min 8 characters). The example sets it to the same value so the collection can be re-run; put a real new password in `new_password` to actually change it.
Totals, status breakdown and today's appointments. Doctors only see their own numbers.
Same, for a given date. `bookingDate` is automatically the next Sunday.

item.name: 3. Patients
item.description: Write access: Admin, Receptionist. Delete: Admin only, and only if the patient has no appointments.

request.description: Paginated list. Response: `{ data: [...], meta: { page, per_page, total, pages } }`.
`full_name` is required. `patient_code` is generated (PAT003, PAT004, …) if you leave it out. `gender`: Male or Female. Saves the new id into `patientId`.
Includes the patient's appointment history.
Send only the fields you want to change.

item.name: 4. Doctors & Schedules
item.description: Write access: Admin only. Everyone logged in can read.

request.description: Creates the login account (with the Doctor role) and the doctor profile together. The email gets a random number so you can run it more than once. Saves the id into `doctorId`.
Includes the weekly schedule.
Set `status: false` to make a doctor inactive (no new bookings).
`day_of_week`: Sunday … Saturday. Blocks on the same day may not overlap. Saves the id into `scheduleId`.
30-minute slots for that day, each with `available: true/false`. Use it to pick a time before booking.

item.name: 5. Appointments
item.description:
Book / edit: Admin, Receptionist. Status change: also the appointment's own doctor. Delete: Admin.

Booking rules: doctor active and working at that time, no overlap for the doctor or the patient, not in the past.

request.description: Books the patient created above with the doctor created above, next Sunday 09:00–09:30. Saves the id into `appointmentId`.
All filters are optional. Doctors only ever get their own appointments.
Moves it to 10:00. Booking rules are checked again.
Cancelling frees the time slot.
Re-opening a cancelled appointment re-checks that the slot is still free.
`roles` is an array of role names: Admin, Receptionist, Doctor. Saves the id into `userId`.
Send only what changes. Add `password` to reset it. The last active Admin cannot lose the Admin role.
Users are never hard-deleted; this disables the account and logs it out everywhere.

item.name: 7. Error examples
item.description:
Requests that are **meant to fail**, so you can see the error format:

```json
{ "error": "message", "errors": { "field": "problem" } }
```

Run these after folders 1–5 (as Admin).

exec: pm.test('Explains the overlap', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.start_time).to.include('already has an appointment'));

request.description: Tries to book over the appointment from folder 5 (rescheduled to 10:00–10:30). The overlap is refused and the response says which appointment is in the way.
The new doctor only works on Sundays.

item.name: 8. Clean up (deletes)
item.description: Delete the records created by this collection. Admin only.

request.description: Hard delete. In normal use prefer cancelling, which keeps history.
Only works when the patient has no appointments (otherwise 409).

exec: pm.test('Deleted (204) or refused because of appointments (409)', () => pm.expect([204, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Only works when the doctor has no appointments; otherwise you get 409 and should set the doctor inactive instead. After a full run the doctor has no appointments left, so this returns 204.

item.name: 9. Other roles & logout
item.description: Log in as a receptionist or doctor to see what they can and cannot do. Run **1. Auth → Login as Admin** again to get admin access back.

request.description: Receptionist: patients and appointments.
Doctor: sees only own appointments; can mark them Completed / No-Show. Saves `myDoctorId`.
Only this doctor's appointments are returned, whatever filters you send.
Invalidates the current token.
